mapper.sql: DASHBOARD_ID, ENTERPRISE_ID, ENTERPRISE_NAME, STATISTICS_PERIOD, OPERATING_REVENUE, NET_PROFIT, TOTAL_ASSETS, NET_ASSETS, ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO, ROE, ROA, REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE, PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE, EMPLOYEE_COUNT, SUBSIDIARY_COUNT, BUSINESS_SEGMENT_COUNT, RISK_LEVEL, RISK_SCORE, WARNING_COUNT, COMPLIANCE_SCORE, DATA_QUALITY_SCORE, SUBMISSION_COMPLETION_RATE, OPERATING_STATUS, DEVELOPMENT_TREND, DATA_STATUS, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG
mapper.select: SELECT FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_DASHBOARD WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY STATISTICS_PERIOD DESC, UPDATE_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ENTERPRISE_NAME as "enterpriseName", INDUSTRY_CLASSIFICATION as "industryClassification", ENTERPRISE_SCALE as "enterpriseScale", LISTING_STATUS as "listingStatus", MAIN_BUSINESS_DESC as "mainBusinessDesc", GEOGRAPHICAL_DISTRIBUTION as "geographicalDistribution", OPERATING_STATUS as "operatingStatus" FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_DASHBOARD WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY STATISTICS_PERIOD DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT OPERATING_REVENUE as "operatingRevenue", NET_PROFIT as "netProfit", TOTAL_ASSETS as "totalAssets", ROE as "roe", REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE as "revenueGrowthRate", PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE as "profitGrowthRate", ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO as "assetLiabilityRatio", ROA as "roa" FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_DASHBOARD WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY STATISTICS_PERIOD DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT SUBSIDIARY_COUNT as "subsidiaryCount", BUSINESS_SEGMENT_COUNT as "businessSegmentCount", EMPLOYEE_COUNT as "employeeCount", DEVELOPMENT_TREND as "developmentTrend", OPERATING_STATUS as "operatingStatus" FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_DASHBOARD WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY STATISTICS_PERIOD DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT RISK_LEVEL as "riskLevel", RISK_SCORE as "riskScore", WARNING_COUNT as "warningCount", COMPLIANCE_SCORE as "complianceScore", CASE WHEN RISK_SCORE >= 80 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN RISK_SCORE >= 60 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END as "riskStatus" FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_DASHBOARD WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY STATISTICS_PERIOD DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT DATA_QUALITY_SCORE as "dataQualityScore", SUBMISSION_COMPLETION_RATE as "submissionCompletionRate", DATA_STATUS as "dataStatus", CASE WHEN SUBMISSION_COMPLETION_RATE >= 95 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN SUBMISSION_COMPLETION_RATE >= 80 THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'POOR' END as "submissionStatus" FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_DASHBOARD WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY STATISTICS_PERIOD DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(STATISTICS_PERIOD, 'YYYY-MM') as "period", OPERATING_REVENUE as "revenue", NET_PROFIT as "profit", TOTAL_ASSETS as "assets", ROE as "roe" FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_DASHBOARD WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY STATISTICS_PERIOD ASC FETCH FIRST #{months} ROWS ONLY
SELECT BUSINESS_NAME as "name", BUSINESS_VALUE as "value" FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_BUSINESS_DISTRIBUTION WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY BUSINESS_VALUE DESC

SELECT PLAN_NAME as "planName", EXECUTION_RATE as "executionRate", TARGET_VALUE as "target", ACTUAL_VALUE as "actual", STATUS as "status" FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_PLAN_EXECUTION WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY EXECUTION_RATE DESC

SELECT BUDGET_NAME as "budgetName", EXECUTION_RATE as "executionRate", BUDGET_AMOUNT as "budget", EXECUTED_AMOUNT as "executed", STATUS as "status" FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_BUDGET_EXECUTION WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY EXECUTION_RATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE GZCT_ENTERPRISE_DASHBOARD SET UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT 'AUTO' as refreshInterval, 'DEFAULT' as theme, '6M' as defaultTimeRange
mapper.update: MERGE INTO DASHBOARD_CONFIG dc USING (SELECT #{enterpriseId} AS ENTERPRISE_ID FROM DUAL) src ON (dc.ENTERPRISE_ID = src.ENTERPRISE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CONFIG_DATA = #{configData}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ENTERPRISE_ID, CONFIG_DATA, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{configData}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highRiskCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN OPERATING_STATUS = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as normalOperatingCount, AVG(DATA_QUALITY_SCORE) as avgDataQualityScore FROM GZCT_ENTERPRISE_DASHBOARD
mapper.update:
